refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the applet refreshes usage data.

show-credits.tooltip: Show the credits balance, extra usage, and auto-recharge in the popup (OpenCode login accounts only).

active-account.tooltip: The account the meter shows; selecting one switches the meter to it.

accounts-apply-button.tooltip: Add an API-key account, or replace the key of an existing one. The key is validated locally and never stored in the applet settings.

accounts-remove-button.tooltip: Remove the account selected above. Removing an API-key account also deletes its stored key.

accounts-activate-button.description: Use the selected login in OpenCode…
accounts-activate-button.tooltip: Point OpenCode itself at the selected pinned OpenCode login, so new OpenCode sessions use it. Only pinned OpenCode logins are eligible; anything else opens a short explainer.
